name: ona-plotter-lint
description: Repo-root lint harness for OnaPlotter's hand-written JS (wwwroot/js interop layer, deploy/ plugin shim, scripts/ build helpers). Catches the TDZ / no-undef class of bug ESLint surfaces statically. The Blazor build depends on node_modules only for esbuild in Release publish; CI runs npm run lint as a gate before the test step.
